data.title: 忍冬 · 给丽萨的信
data.description: 她写完最后一行，把新挑的书签放进信封。落款前，忍冬又添了一句，问丽萨最近的课程是不是还那么忙。
data.action: 写信后把一枚书签放进信封
data.camera: 中近景，信封与钢笔可见
data.promptProse: Seated at a dark mahogany hotel bureau under the pool of a brass desk lamp, Vulpisfoglia carefully writes a personal letter with an ink fountain pen, an open envelope and a colorful dried-flower bookmark resting beside her blotter. The quiet luxury of the room, with heavy damask curtains and leather armchairs, contrasts with her tender, protective thoughts of family.
